proposal_title: Security Model Secret Handling Prose & Redaction Rules Formalization
domain_specific_rationale: As Red Team Specialist with mandatory sign-off authority on security amendments, CP-020 formalizes the concrete security rules and redaction criteria in SECURITY_MODEL.md and ADR-007_BROWSER_SECURITY.md. Formalizing the requirement that telemetry sanitization must mask Authorization, Cookie, set-cookie, and bearer tokens eliminates security ambiguities during automated penetration testing and failure injection audits. It ensures that worker compromises or log pipeline taps cannot extract active operator credentials.
capability_impact: Preserves and formalizes CAP-07 (Security & Isolation) and CAP-15 (Anti-Abuse Compliance).
residual_risk: Residual Risk: Unconventional custom authorization headers or sensitive tokens passed in query parameters/URI paths (such as ?token=... or ?apiKey=...) might evade header-only redaction filters. Required Mitigation: Expand R14 Observability telemetry redaction rules to include URI query parameter masking for known secret parameter names (key, token, secret, sig) and payload body redaction before emitting telemetry.
